name: workbuddy-relay-windows-exe
description: Optional build: bundle wb-setup into a single Windows exe

scripts.build: esbuild entry.mjs --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --minify --legal-comments=none --outfile=out/wb.cjs && pkg out/wb.cjs -t node20-win-x64 -C GZip -o out/WorkBuddy-Relay-Import.exe
